name: Recall Delegation
description: Look up what another agent reported to you EARLIER in this chat. Without arguments it lists the past delegations (id, agent, question, snippet); pass the id of one to read its full reply. Use it instead of saying you do not have the information.

id.description: Id of one past delegation (looks like 'd3'), to read its full reply. Omit to list them.

agent_id.description: Only list delegations to this agent. Omit to list all of them.
